name: Luồng 13: L13_Order_Status – Tra cứu trạng thái đơn hàng

parameters.query:
SELECT t.id AS ticket_id, t.ticket_code, t.customer_id, t.status AS ticket_status,
       t.channel, t.ai_locked,
       c.full_name AS customer_name, c.email AS customer_email,
       c.phone AS customer_phone, c.preferred_language,
       c.telegram_id AS customer_telegram_id
FROM tickets t
LEFT JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.id
WHERE t.id = :ticket_id
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id, o.order_code, o.status, o.ordered_at, o.delivered_at, o.tracking_code, o.total_amount
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id = :customer_id
ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
LIMIT 3;
